delegated_reviews.scope: sanitized project-blind next-slice comparison and contract draft
findings: Capability compatibility is the highest-value orthogonal gap if ranking, routing, policy, delivery, and trust are frozen out.
Use deterministic ternary outcomes and sorted mismatch facts.
Do not import full semver or host-specific capability assumptions.
delegated_reviews.resolution: The executable contract is stateless, uses a frozen numeric version grammar, emits no score or route, and treats named clients as illustrative labels.

findings: Causal acknowledgments overlap delivery and receipt work.
Standalone error precedence lacks a stable operation context.
Capability values must never become routing hints or policy facts.
delegated_reviews.resolution: The slice owns pairwise fixture evaluation only and explicitly excludes causal, routing, delivery, and policy semantics.

findings: Every named client needs representation without provider-specific assumptions.
A simplistic key-intersection boolean is too weak for versions, modes, content types, and tool schemas.
delegated_reviews.resolution: The contract uses opaque labels plus explicit version ranges, alternative intersections, and exact tool schema labels, with illustrative cross-client fixtures.

initial_findings: Hostile __proto__ members were not preserved as own JavaScript object properties.
Incomplete fraction and exponent tokens had divergent parser classifications.
independent_source_reviews.resolution: Null-prototype parser objects, complete numeric-production validation, golden parser classifications, and hostile-key full-transcript parity were added.

independent_source_reviews.scope: Contract, corpus, limits, and differential coverage
initial_findings: Partial content-type absence lacked a mandatory golden case.
Parser and validation classifications lacked independent golden cross-language oracles.
Exact limits and paired list permutations were under-tested.
independent_source_reviews.resolution: Mandatory partial-content coverage, golden parser and validation tables, exact accepted/rejected boundaries, and paired permutation projections were added.

remaining_boundaries: Local commit and external manifest digest custody are packaging gates, not semantic review findings.
The branch remains unmerged and unpushed.
Integration, publication, deployment, activation, and product compatibility claims remain unauthorized.
